title: Tell Claude reviewer leaves how to inspect Git under TermAl's read-only policy
outcome: Tell Claude reviewer leaves how to inspect Git under TermAl's read-only policy
acceptance: A reviewer that still cannot see the diff states that coverage gap explicitly in its result instead of relying on the freeze check alone

The /review-code instructions tell a read-only reviewer to run Git inspection as standalone Bash commands, one per call (git status --short, git diff, git diff --cached, git ls-files --others --exclude-standard), and not through PowerShell or with non-allowlisted helpers such as cmp

completion.summary: /review-code now tells a read-only reviewer to run each Git inspection command (git status --short, git diff, git diff --cached, git ls-files --others --exclude-standard) as its own Bash call from the working directory. It also names what TermAl's read-only policy refuses and why: the PowerShell tool; helpers the policy does not list, such as cmp; Git retargeted with -C, --git-dir, --work-tree or --namespace; and git hash-object. It gives git diff --no-index for comparing files. A reviewer that still cannot see the diff must say so under a new Coverage section, since a passing freeze check never replaces reading the diff. Landed as 2fc696a; independent evaluation passed both criteria.
